title: Iowa’s Toxic Explosion
summary: The Army is scheduled blow up thousands of pounds of explosives that could spread toxic lead dust for miles.
caption: Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, Iowa, where a detonation of lead azide explosives is planned for Wednesday.

title: Ancient Egyptian Cats Lived Squalid Lives Before Mummification
summary: Cats destined to be offerings paid a high price to receive glory in the afterlife, markings on their skulls revealed.
caption: Mummified cats inside a tomb at an ancient necropolis near Egypt’s famed pyramids in 2018.

title: What Personality Can Tell Us About Mental Health
summary: Psychologists and psychiatrists have long considered the role of personality in understanding mental illness and treatment. Now, science is bridging the gap.

title: This Danish Man Was a Rare Witness to the Agricultural Revolution
summary: Excavated in 1956, “Rodhals Man” lived — and ate — at the cusp of one of the biggest shifts in human history, a new study says.
caption: The skull of Rodhals Man, an individual who lived about 6,000 years ago and was buried in a shell midden on an island in Denmark.
